definitions.full: H6323. pun אָפ֑וּנָה Psa 88:16 ( ἄρ . λεγ Dl Pr 135 f. compare Assyrian appuna(ma) adv. = ma°diš , very, very much , but dubious; Thes MV form from √ פון & compare Arabic diminuit, mente diminuit (Frey), hence be confused, helpless , compare ᵐ5 ἐξηπθρήθην ᵑ9 contur-batus sum ; others emend אָפוּגָה from מּוּג q. v. A verb however is not needed for parallelism). **Arabic in fact = milk (camel, etc.) dry, empty ; = empty-headed man ; this does not support be confused, helpless (GFM, privately). [ מּוּן ] verb (?); only אָפוּנָה Psa 88:16 ; read probably אֶמּוֺגָה , see אָפוּנָה פוג, . מּוֺנֶה 2Chr 25:23 see מּוּנִי מִּנָּה, see מּוּאָה . above
